rows.text: The Assembly's ministers page says that before his appointment as a Minister in March 2005 Hon. Tu'ivakano 'was the Speaker of the Legislative Assembly and Tongatapu's Nobles No.1 Representative', that 'He was appointed Speaker by His Majesty on 1st July 2002', and that he was Speaker 'from 2002-2004'.
rows.locator: Profile headed 'Hon. Tu'ivakano - Minister of Works & Disasters Relief Activities'
rows.uncertainty: The Assembly's earliest found statement of 1 July 2002, about three years after the event (the page was last modified on 14 July 2005); attested_on is the day it gives, not a holder date. It conflicts with the government statement of about 23 May 2002 (to_speaker_tuivakano_appointment_reported_20020523), and the conflict is retained. 'From 2002-2004' is not a boundary.

rows.text: The same page says that Hon. Malupo, appointed Governor of Ha'apai in January 2001, 'began his political career in 1993 after being elected the Noble Representative for Ha'apai', and that 'He was also the Acting Speaker of the Legislative Assembly in 2000.'
rows.locator: Profile headed 'Hon. Malupo - Governor of Ha'apai'
rows.uncertainty: Year-only acting service: a claim only, never a holder, and no structured date is stored. It bears on the Assembly's retrospective 'Nopele Malupo 1987 - 1989' entry (to_la_list_malupo_1987_1989_20111130), which may name the title rather than this holder of it.
